description: Fork of exp424 (E=64 + E-residual, NAP=6 everywhere, 46.73M, 1.5390). Double tph in all 4 LUT modules at NAP=6 (no row reduction). LUT params double (32.0M -> 64.1M); total 46.73M -> ~78.8M. Bandwidth (lookups + floats/tok/layer) exactly 2x. Tests pure 'add more tables at full NAP' vs exp426 (constant entries, NAP-shifted) and exp425 (smaller baseline).
